title: Charging Attack - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Charging Attack in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: The Reacher - near the Fading Man, grapple through the gap

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Charging Attack is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Gain Gradient Charge on Base Attack.

sections.title: How to Get Charging Attack
sections.content: Location: The Reacher - near the Fading Man, grapple through the gap.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
